about: Where each of the 52 live-bucket tests of @agentcc/client 1.0.1 (tests/port/manifest.json 'to: live'; names from tests/port/vitest-legacy-client.json) went. to = tests/live/<file> (same test name, run against agentcc-gateway live-gateway-source over the mock upstream) or shim (code that stays only in the @agentcc/client 2.0 shim). New live tests (wire.test.ts, stock/stock-openai.test.ts) are listed under added.

benchmark-v3.test.ts.name: Gateway v3 Benchmark > healthz endpoint
benchmark-v3.test.ts.note: 1.0.1 compared two hand-started gateways (Docker :8090, v3 :8092) and asserted v3.mean < 2 x docker.mean. One build exists here (the pin): it measures that build alone, asserts every answer is 200 and records latencies as evidence; the cross-build ratio is not reproducible.
